name: fredrikolis
description: Tools from fredrikolis. FSA1 stores a spreadsheet as a file tree, so an Excel (.xlsx) or OpenDocument (.ods) workbook becomes greppable, diffable and editable with ordinary file tools.

plugins.name: fsa1
plugins.description: Give Claude spreadsheets it can read and edit as files: tabs become folders, cells become files, so a range is something to grep, diff and edit with ordinary file tools rather than a whole workbook to load. Unpack .xlsx or .ods, render, lint, evaluate and trace it, then pack it back to Excel.
